prompt: Antes de armar el PR hacia develop, revisa el diff que tengo sin commitear ahorita en agrisas-panel (kardex, historial de pagos y el repo de reportes de lista de precios por departamento) contra las reglas del proyecto y las specs de openspec que apliquen. Dime si está listo para mergear o si hay algo bloqueante.
assertions: Resolves scope via git (status/diff against develop), not a guess at what changed
Identifies the touched areas: inventory kardex product search, payments history product search, and the reports department price list repository
Maps the frontend changes to the Arquitectura Frontend / _logic layering rules in CLAUDE.md
Looks up and cites a matching openspec capability (e.g. inventory-kardex-ui, payments-ui, or reports-api/reports-collections-api) instead of skipping spec lookup
Produces a checklist with pass/fail/warning markers and file:line evidence, not unstructured prose
Runs at least one real verification command (build, targeted test, or lint) and reports its actual outcome
Ends with a clear summary distinguishing blocking issues from warnings
